$description: Night theme (dark): a neutral near-black surface, yellow actions. Same keys as day.tokens.json.

maroon-edge.$description: Maroon as an outline: the border of maroon-toned cards, stats and bands. Lifts to a lighter maroon on Night so it still shows (3.5:1 on surface-raised).

surface.$description: Page background. A neutral near-black: maroon stays an accent, never the room.

surface-sunk.$description: Wells, table stripes, quiet section backgrounds.

surface-raised.$description: Cards, menus and dialogs, one step lighter than surface.

ink.$description: Primary text and icons. 15.6:1+ on Night surfaces.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text: intros, hints, metadata. 7.8:1+ on Night surfaces.

line.$description: Decorative hairlines and resting card borders.

line-control.$description: Input and checkbox borders at rest. 3.4:1+ on Night surfaces.

line-strong.$description: Hover border on cards, secondary button border, the selected tab rule.

action.$description: Primary button fill. Maroon on Day, yellow on Night.

action-hover.$description: Primary button fill on hover and press.

on-action.$description: Text and icons on `action` (15.2:1 Day, 9.5:1 Night).

link.$description: Inline links on any surface (6.2:1 Day, 7:1+ Night). Underlined, always.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px gap in the surface color. 6:1 on Day surfaces, 11:1+ on Night.

success.$description: Success text and icons on surfaces and on tint-green.

danger.$description: Error text, icons and destructive actions on surfaces and on tint-red.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on surfaces and on tint-yellow (5:1+).

tint-yellow.$description: Highlight wash: warning notices, selected rows, the new-item tag.

tint-red.$description: Wash behind error notices and soft red tags. Ink on it 15:1+.

tint-green.$description: Wash behind success notices and soft green tags.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Cards on the page use borders, not shadows.
